title: Qualify finite reciprocal PlotModel segment and point-budget research
commitMessage: docs: qualify M7 reciprocal PlotModel research oracles

contribution.summary: Qualify M7-W01-C03-S02-T1 as bounded reciprocal PlotModel data research. Independently check four finite points in two disconnected segments for the 1/x pole at zero, including a grid omitting zero, and reject invalid/nonfinite or over-budget inputs without partial results. Complete T1 Q/O/D only; no renderer, public PlotModel, AURA executor or new package.
contribution.value: A source-only BCL checker tests explicit [-2,-1,0,1,2] segments and skipped-zero topology, an exact eight-sample limit, finite values, monotonic-grid refusals and no partial points. Record SHA-pinned research decision and Math/AURA ownership while retaining RS112's completed pure DAG deferral. Keep S02 T2, original C03, W01 and M7 open.
debtChanges: The finite reciprocal plot fixture is not a PlotModel product API, adaptive sampler, renderer or general discontinuity detector.
Known 1/x pole segmentation must not be generalized silently to arbitrary singularities or inferred continuity from epsilon.
Public plotting needs a named Math consumer, explicit domain/grid/segment and finite resource/cancellation/partial-result policies.
Graphical rendering and AURA task/resource/permission orchestration remain outside Math; no provider or sibling cutover.
S02 T2, original size-L C03, M7-W01 and M7 release remain incomplete after this research T1.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS113 success, prepare M7-W01-C03-S02-T2 to decide finite PlotModel points/segments/domain/budget/partial-output and graphical rendering owner boundaries. Admit no public model or chart renderer without an independent consumer or explicitly defer with a review trigger.

achievements.achievement: Fix a finite reciprocal-only PlotModel research question, known-pole topology, point quotas and distinct Math/AURA ownership.
Prove two disconnected reciprocal segments with four finite points, omitted-zero break and deterministic invalid/nonfinite/budget refusals.
Record research-only point/segment and renderer non-delivery disposition, preserving a separate T2 owner admission gate.
Complete bounded 1/x PlotModel T1 Q/O/D with independent BCL witness groups and no public graph/renderer capability.
